summary: Super Admin Dashboard feature testing completed. All 13 backend tests passed. All 14 frontend features verified working correctly.
passed_tests: 1. Navigate to /admin/dashboard - shows master code verification screen
2. Enter wrong master code - shows error toast 'Código maestro incorrecto'
3. Enter correct master code DEVOTIO-2026-ADMIN - shows dashboard (requires super_admin login)
4. Dashboard shows summary cards: 4 workspaces, 13 users, 116 operations
5. Dashboard lists all workspaces with user count, operations count, locations count, API key status
6. Click workspace to expand - shows detailed stats (admins, operators, locations), user list
8. Reset password modal: auto mode generates Temp-XXXX-XXX password, manual mode allows custom password
9. Toggle workspace active/inactive works (Activar/Desactivar button) - shows 'Inactivo' badge
11. Backend: GET /api/admin/dashboard returns all workspaces with stats
12. Backend: POST /api/admin/dashboard/users/{id}/reset-password resets password with master code
critical_code_review_comments: SuperAdminDashboard.js is well-structured with proper data-testid attributes for testing
Backend endpoints properly validate master code and super_admin role
Password reset correctly hashes new passwords and allows both auto and manual modes
Toggle active/inactive persists to database correctly
Spanish UI maintained throughout (Restablecer, Desactivar, Activar, etc.)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Super Admin Dashboard feature fully tested and working. Key endpoints: POST /api/admin/verify-master-code, GET /api/admin/dashboard, GET /api/admin/dashboard/workspaces/{id}/users, POST /api/admin/dashboard/users/{id}/reset-password, PATCH /api/admin/dashboard/workspaces/{id}/toggle-active. Dashboard shows 4 workspaces: Restaurante Demo, Cafe Demo, Devotio Default, Test Workspace. Password reset tested with both auto (Temp-XXXX-XXX format) and manual modes.

master_code_verification.requires_login: Shows 'Debe iniciar sesión primero' if not logged in
